target.description: Predict inferior-colliculus multi-unit spike-count activity for the original Fig. 4b,d seven-animal/four-sound evaluation. Preserve both trial-specific neural response prediction and reliability-normalized assessment; this scope does not include whole-paper new-animal adaptation or ASR.

dataset.description: Zenodo 12636772 v1: IC_data_trial1.mat, IC_data_trial2.mat and sound_data.mat. Use all four original thirty-second sounds: speech in quiet, speech in noise, band-limited moving ripples and music.

cohort.description: Original evaluation animals 3-9, both successive trials and all source-eligible recorded units (paper Fig. 4d reports 3,476 units across seven animals). These animals were represented during model training; the four evaluation sound excerpts were excluded from training.

split.description: Original model training versus the four held-out evaluation sounds, with both successive evaluation trials used in the source score. The public trial1/trial2 arrays are not a training/test partition. Training on three evaluation sounds, trial1 calibration, or new held-animal folds changes the task and is an extension.

inputs.description: Calibrated audio waveform, original animal decoder identity and the trial/animal-specific measurement time used for non-stationarity. Characteristic-frequency metadata identifies units but must not permit selecting units using evaluation outcomes.

preprocessing.description: Audio rate is 24414.0625 Hz and one neural bin equals 32 audio samples (762.9395 Hz); preserve sound intensities and exact measurement times. Paper evaluates only units with repeated-broadband-noise reliability at least 0.2. The exact reliability mask, initial-context crop/alignment and native prediction-to-trial mapping have not been verified.

metric.description: Primary explained correlation (%) = 50*[rho(vec(R1),vec(Rhat1)) + rho(vec(R2),vec(Rhat2))]/rho(vec(R1),vec(R2)), equation (3). Rhat is sampled model activity; the separate variance metric uses predicted expected counts and source equations (4)-(5). Raw RMSE or ordinary correlation is not interchangeable.

aggregation.description: Fig. 4b flattens time and eligible units within each animal, reports all seven animal scores per sound and displays their distribution; Fig. 4d scores individual units separately. Recover the exact reduction underlying the textual per-sound numbers before scalar grading. No newly invented average across sounds or subset of easy units can replace the source endpoint.

full_panel.description: The complete original source scope below is identified, but the current v1 scalar findings retain only11 printed summaries. Native animal/unit distributions, count-probability tensors and companion profiles require structured-output support; full-panel computational reproduction is not represented by these exposed summaries. Original Fig. 4b,d evaluation only: animals 3-9, speech_in_quiet, speech_in_noise, moving_ripples and music, both successive trials and all 3,476 source-eligible units. Retain all 28 animal/sound cases with separate equation (3) correlation and equations (4)-(5) variance metrics; the eight printed per-sound ICNet summaries are additional source claims, not replacements for those 56 animal metrics. Reconstruct Fig. 4d ICNet and original LNP values for every eligible unit for each sound and both metrics, preserving all signed/out-of-range values and undefined-value handling; reproduce each source median, 25th/75th percentile and 1.5 IQR whisker from that complete population. Retain Fig. 4e per-unit mean recorded count, trial-to-trial correlation and CF identities and the three reported activity/CF/reliability associations with performance, including the distinct3,406-unit set after the source top/bottom 1% exclusions. Four-primary-sound magnitude/coherence companion profiles referenced in Supplementary Fig. 2 must be retained and independently reconciled before admission; their exact source axes, reductions and acceptance criteria remain unresolved. This complete original panel is not the four-new-sound/four-animal Fig. 4c experiment, new-animal adaptation, ASR or the whole 14-animal paper.

permitted_observations.description: For original neural prediction, preserve calibrated audio, original animal decoder identity and trial-specific measurement times in seconds; original CF/unit identifiers establish joins and the independent source broadband-noise reliability mask, not outcome-selected units. Both published successive-trial response arrays are evaluation observations for reliability and reproduction analysis, not a trial1 training/trial2 test split; none of the four evaluation sounds may become predictor-development data. Paper+data and paper+data+author-code must share the same authentic recordings, source identities, permitted observations and evaluator; authenticated author code is the sole information addition in the latter condition, with no currently frozen paired package. Printed claims are allowed inputs and cannot establish computation. Independent execution must retain ICNet native count probabilities, sampled counts and separately derived expected counts for every trial/case; LNP Poisson rates/expected counts, sampled counts and original model/kernel provenance; full source mask, time/crop/column joins, all equations (3)-(5) intermediates, per-unit metrics and reliability/CF companions. The verifier must derive reports from those authentic granular outputs using the existing source-equation component and separately verified source-native companion calculations. Neither a program printing tables nor a source-code/calibration/software-control receipt can populate an AI outcome. Original training/validation access, exact mask and alignment, LNP release, stochastic draws, evaluator identities, exposure history and paired budgets remain unresolved.
